meta.title: After the end is pulled in, a vendor cannot bid
meta.source: llm-fast (read-back removed after a false live failure)

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The buyer pulls the end in to 90 seconds from now.
Wait until the pulled-in bid end passes.
QA vendor tries to place a bid after the pulled-in end.
As the buyer, read the pricing round and check that the round counts no new bid (the refused bid left nothing).
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “Order not active”, and never with a server error. Read back afterwards: the round counts no new bid (the refused bid left nothing).

plan.title: After the end is pulled in, a vendor cannot bid

act.say: The buyer pulls the end in to 90 seconds from now.
Wait until the pulled-in bid end passes.
QA vendor tries to place a bid after the pulled-in end.

assert.say: the round counts no new bid (the refused bid left nothing)
